text:
SoFi Stadium mepere na 8 September 2020 na Inglewood, California, na-arị elu n’ala Hollywood Park Racetrack ochie n’ime mmepe Hollywood Park. Ndị HKS, Inc. mere ya, e wepụtara ihe ruru $5.5 ijeri ka ọ na-erule May 2020, na-eme ya otu n’ime ama egwuregwu kacha ọnụ e wulitere. Ndị StadCo LA na Hollywood Park Land Company nwere ya, nke metụtara Stan Kroenke.

E chepụtara ebe a ka ụlọ maka ndị otu NFL abụọ, Los Angeles Rams na Los Angeles Chargers, ha abụọ bi ebe ahụ kemgbe 2020. Ihe pụrụ iche ya bụ canopy ETFE na-enweghị ihe na-ekpuchi ihe dị ka otu nde square feet n’elu panel 302, n’okpuru ya ka a kwụnyere bọọdụ vidiyo 4K Infinity Screen nwere akụkụ abụọ.

Site na oge mbụ ya, ama egwuregwu ahụ dọtara ihe omume kacha ibu na egwuregwu America. Ọ nabatara Super Bowl LVI na February 2022, ebe Rams meriri Bengals 23-20, ma mee 2023 College Football Playoff National Championship. Akụkọ ihe mere eme bọọlụ ya malitere ịrị elu, ebe egwuregwu CONCACAF na CONMEBOL dị elu na-eweta ndị mba ụwa na Inglewood.

Maka World Cup, a kpọrọ ama egwuregwu ahụ "Los Angeles Stadium" n’okpuru iwu FIFA nke clean-venue, neutral-naming, ebe ikike ya nke 70,240 ka edozigharịrị na 70,492 nke FIFA kwadoro maka asọmpi ahụ. E wepụrụ turf artificial ya ma dochie ya na pitch natural-grass, hybrid Kentucky bluegrass nke toro n’elu usoro drainage na ventilation nwere ọkụ na-eto iji kwado ahịhịa dị ndụ n’okpuru canopy.

Na-aga n’ihu, SoFi Stadium ga-anabata emume mmeghe na mmechi nke 2028 Summer Olympics, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ otu n’ime ama egwuregwu kacha ama n’oge ya. N’oge dị mkpụmkpụ, ọ si n’ala ịnyịnya gaa n’otu n’ime ama egwuregwu kacha ama n’ụwa, na-anabata oge NFL, Super Bowl, na egwuregwu zuru ụwa ọnụ ugbu a.
